integrity: The exact K5 base case has prior coverage; new scope is class-wide K3,3-minor-free extensions and their optimal-center geometry. The all-graph proof relies on the cited primary facet theorem; finite checks only corroborate exact algebra. Bibliographic completeness and independent mathematical validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The factor-five theorem assumes a K5 subgraph and excludes K3,3 minors. The exact center dimension and complete facet-coordinate description require edge-maximality on a fixed vertex set; arbitrary graphs with only a K5 minor are not included.
title: A fivefold asymmetry barrier and center-dimensional transition for \(K_{3,3}\)-minor-free cut polytopes
